summary.text: Chad Perkins is a Republican state representative from Maine House District 31 who is running for Maine State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is not seeking re-election to the House.
He assumed office in the House on December 6, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Chad Perkins lives in Dover-Foxcroft, Maine, and served in the U.S. Army.
His career experience includes working as a consultant and in law enforcement.
